title: Cherry Creeper
description: Replaces vanilla Creeper with female cherry version
body:
|**Cherry Creeper / Need [Optifine](https://optifine.net/home), (or mods like etf, emf, etc. that will make this work on Fabric)** |:---:| ______________________________________________________________________________ |**A Resource Pack that turns all Creepers into a cherry version, meaning that they all become Creepers with the color and material of cherry trees (sakura, if you prefer). In addition, gunpowder, TNT, Creebet painting, and others have been modified/redrawn to match the new Creeper appearance.** |:---:| ``` Works for 1.19.2+ and higher ```
______________________________________________________________________________ |**In the game, its name was also changed from "Creeper" to "Cherry Creeper". In addition, this resource pack is planned to receive updates in the future if we see that you like it.** |:---:|
______________________________________________________________________________
Author's permission for remake
